I'm saving up for|I spend my pocket money on|A good way to save money is

text_en: Last summer, Mai wanted to buy a new camera, but she couldn't afford it.
She decided to start a small business.
She made a lemonade stall in front of her house.
Lemons, sugar and cups cost thirty thousand dong.
She sold each cup for five thousand dong.
On the first day, she sold twenty cups.
After four weeks, Mai calculated her savings.
She had enough money for a second-hand camera.
She was very proud because she earned the money herself.
Now she wants to save up for a bike!

questions.q: Why did Mai start a business?
options: She wanted to buy a camera.
questions.answer: She wanted to buy a camera.

questions.q: How much did Mai sell each cup for?
What did Mai buy in the end?
